battle.name: 烏干達-坦桑尼亞戰爭
battle.theater: 卡加拉河谷與烏干達中部戰線
battle.brief: 一九七八年十月三十日，阿明下令越過卡加拉河侵入坦桑尼亞，戰爭由邊境衝突演成推翻政權；一九七九年四月十日聯軍進軍坎帕拉，六月三日坦軍開始撤出。卡面這支一八四〇年法國雷管步槍早退役百餘年，它留下的「底火不怕潮、精度足以打散隊形」的血統，最後以七六二毫米步槍的樣子出現在兩軍手上。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方是烏干達與坦桑尼亞兩個東非國家，外加雙方的外援與流亡武裝。烏干達方面，總統伊迪·阿明兼任武裝部隊最高指揮者，首都坎帕拉的國防部與參謀部直接調度正規軍，參戰兵力在七萬人以上，其中相當一部分是民兵、地方武裝與新入營而未經訓練的士兵；利比亞依阿明之請派出約二千五百人的部隊，另有一批受巴勒斯坦解放組織支援的游擊隊在鄉間作戰，巴基斯坦與沙特阿拉伯提供後勤與經濟援助。坦桑尼亞方面，總統朱利葉斯·尼瑞爾自任最高決策者，國防軍作戰序列在開戰前約四萬人，動員之後連同警察、獄警、後備役與民兵增到十萬人以上；一九七八年底在肯尼亞內羅畢召開的流亡反對派聯席會議上，二十多個反阿明組織被整合到同一條線上，一九七九年三月磨西會議進一步組成烏干達全國解放軍，下轄蒂托·奧凱洛與大衛·奧伊特-奧喬克率領的「特種部隊」、約韋里·穆塞韋尼率領的「救國陣線」以及阿肯納·普奧約克率領的「拯救烏干達運動」等二十八個單位；莫三比克與尚比亞、安哥拉、衣索比亞、阿爾及利亞、中國等國在外交與物資上提供支援。戰場橫跨坦桑尼亞西北部的卡加拉河谷與烏干達西部的姆巴拉拉、馬薩卡，中部的坎帕拉、恩德培、金賈，直到東部的托羅羅，是一場由邊境衝突一路打進首都的戰爭。
countriesEn: The belligerents in this war were the two East African states of Uganda and Tanzania, together with foreign auxiliaries and exile formations on each side. On the Ugandan side President Idi Amin acted as the supreme commander of the armed forces, and the defence ministry and general staff in Kampala ran the regular army directly. The committed force numbered more than seventy thousand men, a substantial part of it made up of militia, local levies and recruits who had never been trained. Libya sent some two thousand five hundred men at Amin's request, and a set of guerrilla bands operating in the countryside was supported by the Palestine Liberation Organisation, while Pakistan and Saudi Arabia provided logistics and economic aid. On the Tanzanian side President Julius Nyerere took the highest decisions himself. The order of battle of the People's Defence Force stood at about forty thousand men before the war and was swelled by police, prison guards, reservists and militia to more than one hundred thousand. At the joint meeting of exiled opposition groups held in Nairobi, Kenya, at the end of 1978, more than twenty anti-Amin organisations were drawn onto a single line, and the Moshi conference of March 1979 went on to form the Uganda National Liberation Army, embracing twenty-eight units including the Kikosi Maalum led by Tito Okello and David Oyite-Ojok, the FRONASA led by Yoweri Museveni, and the Save Uganda Movement led by Akena Pwoogi. Mozambique, and Zambia, Angola, Ethiopia, Algeria and China gave diplomatic and material support. The battlefield ran from the Kagera valley in north-western Tanzania through Mbarara and Masaka in western Uganda, Kampala, Entebbe and Jinja in the centre, to Tororo in the east: a war that began as a frontier clash and ended at the gates of a capital.
people: 決定開打的是坦桑尼亞總統朱利葉斯·尼瑞爾。阿明撕毀兩國默契、越境襲擊卡加拉區之後，他於一九七八年十一月二日正式宣戰，並把目標從「把越境部隊趕回坦境」升級為「打倒阿明」；坦方的作戰指揮由人民國防軍參謀部與前線各旅分層負責，總理阿卜杜拉·特瓦利布與杜邁尼爾·基瓦魯等政治人物在首都一線督戰。對面的最高決策者是伊迪·阿明，他自一九七一年政變掌權後清洗軍隊與政府，趕走了總統米爾頓·奧博特；他以反擊「一千輛坦克越境」為名發動戰爭，戰前又在一場「交通意外」中廢掉副總統穆斯特發·阿德里斯，種下軍心分裂的根由。關鍵的外部人物是卡扎菲，他在阿明最危急時派來約二千五百人的利比亞部隊與坦克、火箭砲、戰鬥機，令盧卡雅的戰局一度逆轉；被擊潰後，他於一九七九年四月初把部隊撤走，阿明則在三月二十七日逃離坎帕拉、四月流亡利比亞。反對陣線裡，米爾頓·奧博特是最終回國執政的人，一九七九年四月十三日被推舉為臨時總統的是前大學校長尤素福·盧萊，隨後是戈弗雷·比奈薩與保羅·穆萬加的軍委會，約韋里·穆塞韋尼與蒂托·奧凱洛則在戰後分別走上武裝反對與軍事政變兩條路。
peopleEn: The man who decided to fight was the Tanzanian president Julius Nyerere. After Amin tore up the tacit understandings between the two countries and sent his troops across the border into the Kagera region, Nyerere formally declared war on 2 November 1978 and raised the aim from simply expelling the invaders to bringing down Amin altogether. On the Tanzanian side the conduct of operations was divided between the general staff of the People's Defence Force and the brigade commanders in the line, with politicians such as Prime Minister Abdallah Twalib and Dominic Kiwuru pressing the effort from the capital. The opposing supreme decision-maker was Idi Amin, who had seized power in the 1971 coup, purged the army and the government, and driven out President Milton Obote. He launched the war under the pretext of repelling a crossing by a thousand tanks, and shortly beforehand he had disabled Vice-President Mustafa Adrisi in a road accident, laying the ground for the army to split. The decisive outside figure was Muammar Gaddafi, who sent about two thousand five hundred Libyan troops with tanks, rocket launchers and fighters when Amin was closest to collapse; after their defeat at Lukaya he withdrew them in the first days of April 1979, and Amin fled Kampala on 27 March and went into exile in Libya. On the opposition side Milton Obote was the man who eventually came back to rule; the presidency that the Tanzanians handed to the former university vice-chancellor Yusuf Lule on 13 April 1979 was followed by Godfrey Binaisa and then the military commission of Paul Muwanga, while Yoweri Museveni and Tito Okello went on to take the road of armed opposition and of a coup respectively.
kits: 卡面這支一八四〇年法國雷管步槍，是擊發技術的定型之作：以底火取代火燧機，槍機結構簡單、對濕氣不敏感，線膛配合錐形彈讓精度與有效射程同時上一級，「一次點火、一發命中」由偶然變成可控；它帶來的後果正是卡面那句話——射程變長，隊形就散了，密集方陣退化成散兵線，步槍兵的戰鬥力從此要靠編制與火力密度補回來。本役的裝備離它已有一百三十八年，血脈卻清清楚楚：坦軍步兵以中國製五六式步槍、五六式輕機槍與衝鋒槍為主，輔以蘇制 AK-47 與 RPG-7 火箭筒，彈藥是七六二毫米與一四五毫米中間威力這一系；重裝備有蘇制 BM-21「喀秋莎」多管火箭砲、中國製五九式戰車與自走砲，坦桑尼亞空軍使用中國製殲-六與殲-七B 戰鬥機。烏軍的裝備多為英制與蘇制舊式步槍，砲兵車輛數量有限，戰機多屬早年購入的舊機型，因零件與燃油短缺而大部分停飛；利比亞援軍則帶來 T-54 與 T-55 坦克、BTR 步兵戰車、BM-21 火箭砲、MiG-21 戰鬥機與 Tu-22 轟炸機。補給上，坦方以數千輛卡車組成縱隊式「水管」供應線，烏方多靠步行與徵用車輛，利比亞部隊則用援軍卡車搬運戰利品撤退。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on the card, a French weapon of 1840, was the finished form of the percussion ignition: a primer cap replaced the flintlock, the lock was simple and undeteriorated by damp, and a rifled barrel with the conical Minié bullet lifted accuracy and effective range at the same time, turning a single pull of the trigger into a reliable hit rather than a chance one. The consequence is exactly the sentence on the card: as range grew, formations came apart, the dense square dissolved into the skirmish line, and the fighting power of a rifleman thereafter had to be made up by organisation and by density of fire. The weapons of this war stand a hundred and thirty-eight years away from it, yet the descent is plain to follow. Tanzanian infantry fought with Chinese Type 56 rifles, Type 56 light machine guns and submachine guns, supported by Soviet AK-47 rifles and RPG-7 launchers, firing the 7.62mm and 14.5mm intermediate cartridges. Heavy equipment comprised Soviet BM-21 Katyusha rocket launchers, Chinese Type 59 tanks and self-propelled guns, and the Tanzanian air force flew Chinese-built J-6 and J-7B fighters. The Ugandan forces were equipped largely with older British and Soviet rifles, had a limited number of artillery vehicles, and their aircraft were mostly obsolete types bought years earlier, grounded for want of spares and fuel. The Libyan auxiliaries brought T-54 and T-55 tanks, BTR infantry fighting vehicles, BM-21 rocket launchers, MiG-21 fighters and Tu-22 bombers. On the logistics side the Tanzanians built a pipeline of several thousand lorries along the line of advance, the Ugandans relied on foot movement and on requisitioned vehicles, and the Libyans used their trucks to carry plunder away as they withdrew.
tactics: 坦方前期的教訓是準備不足：阿明的越境部隊在幾天之內吃掉了整個卡加拉區，坦軍只能退守邊境，遲到十一月底才封住突破口，十二月把烏軍逐出坦境。此後尼瑞爾接納流亡反對派參戰，戰術重心由邊境反擊改成攻擊。一九七九年一月，先頭的一萬餘名坦軍在五九式戰車、殲-六與殲-七B 護航下越境，以 BM-21 火箭砲先打烏軍的集結地與營地，再以裝甲加步兵沿姆巴拉拉—馬薩卡—坎帕拉公路縱隊推進，前進速度取決於卡車與燃料，戰線一旦拉長就必須停下整補。盧卡雅一役最能看出其戰法：北面沼澤擋住正面，坦軍讓二〇一旅涉水強渡，同時以裝備較好的二〇八旅向西南迂迴沼澤西側；三月十日利比亞精銳以十五輛 T-55、數十輛步兵戰車與火箭砲空襲二〇一旅得手，但三月十一至十二日重新集結的兩旅南北夾擊，把利軍打崩。空戰同樣決定性：坦空軍連續多日轟炸坎帕拉、金賈與托羅羅，摧毀烏軍與利軍的有生力量，卡扎菲四月初派出的 Tu-22 投彈未命中任何目標。烏軍則以鬆散、缺油少彈的游擊式退卻應付，士氣在三月崩潰，四月十日聯軍攻入坎帕拉時只遇到零星抵抗。
tacticsEn: The first lesson on the Tanzanian side was a lack of preparation. Within a few days Amin's invading troops had overrun the whole Kagera region, and the Tanzanians could only fall back to the border, plugging the breach only late in November and pushing the Ugandans out of Tanzania during December. From then on Nyerere took the exile groups into his coalition and the purpose of the campaign changed from a border counter-attack to an invasion. In January 1979 an advance force of more than ten thousand Tanzanian troops crossed the border under the cover of Type 59 tanks and J-6 and J-7B fighters, opened with Soviet BM-21 rocket salvos against the Ugandan assembly areas and camps, and then pushed north along the Mbarara-Masaka-Kampala road in armoured and infantry columns, the pace of the advance being set by trucks and fuel, so that the line had to halt for resupply whenever it stretched too thin. The fighting at Lukaya shows their method best. Swamps to the north blocked the direct approach, so the Tanzanians sent the 201st Brigade to force its way across the water while the better equipped 208th Brigade swung south-west round the western edge of the marsh. On 10 March a Libyan elite force with fifteen T-55 tanks, several dozen infantry fighting vehicles and BM-21 rocket launchers bombed the 201st Brigade from the air and routed it, but on 11 and 12 March the two brigades, once regrouped, closed from the south and the north-west and destroyed the Libyans. The air war was decisive in the same way: the Tanzanian air force bombed Kampala, Jinja and Tororo on successive days and wrecked the fighting power of the Ugandan and Libyan forces, while the Tu-22 sent by Gaddafi in the first days of April dropped its bombs without hitting a target. The Ugandans answered with a loose, short of fuel and ammunition, guerrilla-style withdrawal, their morale broke in March, and when the coalition entered Kampala on 10 April it met only scattered resistance.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。戰爭自一九七八年十月三十日阿明下令越境起，到一九七九年六月三日坦軍開始撤出為止，歷時七個月又三週又十二天，地點是坦桑尼亞卡加拉區與烏干達大部分領土。兵力方面，烏干達軍隊七萬餘人，利比亞派遣軍約三千人，坦桑尼亞軍隊十萬餘人，烏干達全國解放軍六千餘人；真正投入一九七九年一月攻勢的先頭部隊約一萬人。傷亡方面，烏軍約一千人陣亡，利比亞軍約四百人，坦軍三百七十三人，解放軍一百五十人。日程極為密集：十一月二日尼雷爾宣戰，十一月底坦軍封住卡加拉，十二月烏軍退出坦境；一九七九年三月十日利軍在盧卡雅擊潰二〇一旅，三月十一至十二日坦軍反擊得手，三月二十七日阿明逃離坎帕拉，四月一日 Tu-22 空襲落空、恩德培同時失守，四月十日聯軍進軍坎帕拉、四月十一日占領，四月十三日盧萊被推舉為臨時總統，六月三日開始撤軍。地理上，穆萬薩至坎帕拉的公路約九百公里，卡加拉河谷至坎帕拉直線約六百公里；盧卡雅之戰利軍精銳投入十五輛 T-55 坦克、數十部步兵戰車與 BM-21 火箭砲。另有阿明宣稱此前已有一千輛坦克越境之說，與實際可見的兵裝並不相符。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The war ran from 30 October 1978, when Amin ordered the crossing, to 3 June 1979, when the Tanzanian troops began to withdraw, a space of seven months, three weeks and twelve days, fought in the Kagera region of Tanzania and over most of Ugandan territory. On strength, the Ugandan army numbered more than seventy thousand men, the Libyan expeditionary force about three thousand, the Tanzanian army more than one hundred thousand, and the Uganda National Liberation Army more than six thousand; the actual advance force committed to the offensive of January 1979 was about ten thousand men. On losses, the Ugandan army lost roughly one thousand dead, the Libyan force about four hundred, the Tanzanian army 373, and the liberation army 150. The timetable is very crowded: Nyerere declared war on 2 November, the Tanzanians sealed the Kagera front at the end of November, and the Ugandans were out of Tanzania by December; on 10 March 1979 the Libyans routed the 201st Brigade at Lukaya, the Tanzanian counter-attack succeeded on 11 and 12 March, Amin fled Kampala on 27 March, on 1 April the Tu-22 raid missed and Entebbe fell, the coalition entered Kampala on 10 April and occupied it on the 11th, Lule was proposed as interim president on 13 April, and the withdrawal began on 3 June. On geography, the road from Mwanza to Kampala is about nine hundred kilometres and the straight line from the Kagera valley to Kampala about six hundred; the Libyan elite at Lukaya committed fifteen T-55 tanks, several dozen infantry fighting vehicles and BM-21 rocket launchers. There is also Amin's claim that a thousand tanks had crossed into Uganda earlier, which does not match the weapons actually seen.
cause: 導火索是阿明一方的越境襲擊。兩國原本關係不錯，奧博特與尼雷爾在獨立運動時期就是舊交，一九六七年還與肯亞組建東非共同體；一九七一年阿明趁奧博特出訪新加坡發動政變，奧博特流亡坦桑尼亞，一九七二年在尼雷爾支持下率一千五百名支持者自坦桑尼亞北部攻入烏干達失敗，阿明遷怒坦籍青年，殺害二十四人，兩國自此交惡。到一九七八年，阿明政權在咖啡價格崩跌、軍隊腐化、清洗蘭芝族與阿喬利族、九月全國騷亂與十月初刺殺未遂之後已經瀕臨崩潰，外界普遍認為他發動戰爭是為了轉移矛盾。一九七八年十月三十日，阿明對坦桑尼亞宣戰，下令部隊越過卡加拉河，並聲稱卡加拉區原本就屬於烏干達、此前已有一千輛坦克入侵，所以是自衛反擊。坦方先求自衛，把越境部隊趕出卡加拉區；尼雷爾向非洲統一組織求援而只得到不干涉的沉默，遂於十一月二日宣戰，把反擊進行到底。
causeEn: The trigger was the crossing into Tanzanian territory by Amin's army. Relations between the two countries had once been good: Obote and Nyerere were old friends from the independence movement, and in 1967 Uganda joined Kenya and Tanzania in the East African Community. In 1971 Amin seized power in a coup while Obote was visiting Singapore; Obote fled into exile in Tanzania, and in 1972 he tried to march into Uganda from northern Tanzania with fifteen hundred supporters with Nyerere's backing, and failed, whereupon Amin took out his anger on Tanzanian young men and killed twenty-four of them, and the two countries fell out. By 1978 the Amin regime, hit by the collapse in coffee prices, by military corruption, by the massacres of the Langi and Acholi, by nationwide rioting in September and by an unsuccessful attempt on his own life in early October, was close to collapse, and it was widely held that he started the war to divert attention from his internal troubles. On 30 October 1978 Amin declared war on Tanzania, ordered his troops across the Kagera, and claimed that the Kagera region had always belonged to Uganda and that a thousand tanks had already invaded, so that his move was pure self-defence. The Tanzanians at first sought only to clear their own territory, but Nyerere's appeal to the Organisation of African Unity met with a silence of non-interference, so on 2 November he declared war and carried the counter-offensive through to the end.
impact: 這是非洲去殖民化完成之後，大陸上第一次由一國以武力推翻另一國的政權。烏干達的後果最為深遠：阿明垮台流亡，盧萊、比奈薩、穆萬加的軍委會、奧博特回國接連上來，一九八〇年十二月奧博特當選後，穆塞韋尼指責選舉舞弊，率人民抵抗軍打起持續多年的叢林戰爭，直到一九八六年推翻奧博特才告一段落；解放軍接管後的治理混亂與政治暴力長期消耗這個國家。坦桑尼亞雖是勝方，代價卻不輕：戰爭造成短期內難以恢復的破壞與龐大軍費，戰後還要在烏境內長期駐軍擔當維和角色，國庫為之空虛，幾年後尼雷爾也因國內經濟衰退而辭職；此役還令坦桑尼亞與剛果民主共和國、肯亞等鄰國關係一度惡化，國際上也有人質疑一國以武力改變他國政權的做法。
impactEn: This was the first time since decolonisation that one African state had overturned the government of another by force. The consequences were deepest in Uganda. Amin collapsed and went into exile; Lule, Binaisa, the military commission of Muwanga and the return of Obote followed one another in quick succession; after Obote won the election of December 1980, Museveni accused the poll of being rigged, raised the People's Resistance Army and fought a bush war that ran for years and did not end until he overthrew Obote in 1986; and the disorder and political violence that followed the takeover by the liberation army drained the country for a long time. Tanzania was the victor but paid for it: the war brought damage that could not be repaired quickly and a military bill of size, the occupation of Uganda had to be maintained for a long stretch in a peacekeeping role, the treasury was left empty, and a few years later Nyerere too resigned because of the decline of the domestic economy. The campaign also soured relations between Tanzania and its neighbours such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Kenya for a time, and there was international unease about a state changing another state's government by force.
result: 結果是坦桑尼亞的徹底勝利與阿明政權的垮台。戰局的轉折點在盧卡雅：利比亞精銳一度擊潰坦軍二〇一旅，但三月十一至十二日重新集結的二〇一旅與二〇八旅南北夾擊，把利軍的裝備與士氣一併打散；坦空軍隨後連續轟炸坎帕拉、金賈與托羅羅，摧毀了烏軍與利軍的有生力量，三月二十七日阿明棄坎帕拉逃往金賈，四月一日恩德培失守，四月十日聯軍進軍坎帕拉、四月十一日占領，全城只遇零星抵抗，戰爭至此基本結束。六月三日坦軍開始撤出，烏干達全國解放軍接管政權，四月十三日盧萊被推舉為臨時總統。坦軍在烏干達的駐紮延續了一段時間，其後逐步撤回；但勝仗並沒有帶來穩定，政權更迭之後是比奈薩被軍委會撤職、奧博特回國、選舉爭議與叢林戰爭，戰爭留下的種子比它推翻的政權活得更久。對坦桑尼亞而言，這是一場贏了戰役卻付出國力的戰爭，也是它以武力改變鄰國政權這一步的起點。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Tanzanian victory and the fall of the Amin regime. The turning point was Lukaya. The Libyan elite routed the Tanzanian 201st Brigade, but on 11 and 12 March the 201st and 208th brigades, once regrouped, closed from the south and the north-west and broke the equipment and the morale of the Libyan force alike. The Tanzanian air force then bombed Kampala, Jinja and Tororo on successive days and wrecked the fighting power of the Ugandan and Libyan troops; on 27 March Amin left Kampala for Jinja, Entebbe fell on 1 April, the coalition entered Kampala on 10 April and occupied it on the 11th against only scattered resistance, and the war was essentially over. The Tanzanians began to withdraw on 3 June, the Uganda National Liberation Army took over, and Lule was proposed as interim president on 13 April. Tanzanian troops stayed on in Uganda for a period of time and were then withdrawn gradually, but the victory brought no stability: after the change of government came Binaisa's removal by the military commission, Obote's return, the disputed election and the bush war, and the seeds of the war outlived the regime it had overthrown. For Tanzania this was a war won at the cost of the treasury, and the beginning of a step by which it changed the government of a neighbouring country by force.
